title: Interregional contingency catalog and evacuation scripts for graceful active-passive promotion
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Create an interregional contingency catalog and a set of evacuation scripts to safely promote passive regions to active under SLO constraints. This ticket covers: canonical activation choreography, traffic triage rules, circuit breaker tuning for progressive promotion, automated backup/restore validation steps, and a scheduled drill harness for rehearsals with verification artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical evacuation script that promotes a passive region to active with deterministic steps and automated safety checks exists in ops-scripts repo (PR reference).
Playbook enforces SLO-aware traffic ramp (percent-per-minute) and integrates circuit-breaker thresholds to avoid cascading failures.
Backup/restore validation runbook includes checksum-based snapshot verification and end-to-end smoke tests that validate tokenstore, cached KV, and routing tables post-restore.
Scheduled drill harness can run a non-disruptive rehearsal against a shadow prefix and produce a drill report with latency, error, and token-cost deltas.
Runbook and scripts have passed tabletop review with PM, Oncall, and Security and are documented in Confluence with runbook link.
playbook_steps: 1) Pre-flight: verify snapshots taken < 10m before drill; SLO burn-rate baseline captured; NOC notified; create drill-ticket in Incident board.
2) Lock control-plane writes to passive region and take incremental snapshot of tokenstore and index metadata. Export routing table and active session markers.
3) Initiate circuit-breaker mode in primary to start shedding lowest-priority traffic (classes defined in traffic-policy config).
4) Boot passive region nodes in promotion mode using orchestration script; mount snapshot and run integrity checksum verifier.
5) Run automated smoke suite: auth flow, 3 canonical gen prompts, KV read-after-write, embedding pipeline sanity check. Abort if any smoke test fails with fatal errors.

6) Ramp traffic: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% in 3-minute intervals; at each step monitor latency p99, error rate, and queue growth; circuit-breaker thresholds may pause ramp if degradation > configured hysteresis.
7) Post-promotion: reconcile KV deltas and run snapshot compare tool; publish drill artifacts and telemetry snapshots to DR-dashboard; if mismatch > tolerance, initiate rollback procedure.
8) Rollback: redirect traffic back to primary region, mark promoted nodes for forensic logs collection, and schedule a follow-up root-cause analysis if rollback occurred.
backup_restore_validation: Snapshot cadence: hourly full + 15m incremental for tokenstore and index metadata during high-traffic windows.
Validator steps: mount snapshot, run kv-checksum tool, sample 5000 keys across namespaces and compare checksums and TTLs, validate embedding vectors dimension and dtype.
Restore smoke tests: auth, prefix-cached continuation, kv-write+read, long-context generation (>=1024 tokens) to validate KV cache warmup behavior.
Integrity gates: checksum match >= 99.995%; API smoke error rate <= 0.1% for test set; any gate fail marks restore as invalid and triggers investigation.
drill_harness: drill-runner CLI that can execute playbook steps in dry-run and live modes (repo: github.com/redwood/ops-scripts PR #487).
Shadow-prefix mode: run routing with prefix to mirror production traffic without affecting customers, collect end-to-end latency histograms.
Telemetry outputs: p50/p95/p99 latency, error classification (client vs server vs deps), token cost delta, kv-miss rate, circuit-breaker triggers per minute.
Automated drill report generator that uploads JSON artifacts to s3 and creates a summary in Confluence with digest and recommended mitigations.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: cascading latency increase during ramp. Mitigation: conservative ramp with circuit-breaker hysteresis and immediate rollback gates.
Risk: snapshot corruption or mismatch. Mitigation: validate snapshots with multi-pass checksum and hold promotion until green.
Risk: insufficient capacity in passive region. Mitigation: preflight capacity reservation and quick-scale play to provision extra capacity before traffic ramp.
Risk: noisy neighbor effects post-promotion. Mitigation: per-tenant rate caps and priority-based shedding enabled for first 30 minutes.
monitoring_and_alerts: Create temporary SLO windows for drill baseline comparison (drill.<ticket>).
Alert: p99 latency increase > 2x baseline for 5m -> SEV3 and halt ramp.
Alert: total error-rate increase > 0.5% absolute for 3m -> SEV2 and pause promotion; if persists 10m escalate to SEV1.
Alert: circuit-breaker open events > 10/min -> trigger automated rollback job.
